name: Okta — Adversary-in-the-Middle Authentication Indicator
xql_query:
dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter eventType = "user.session.start" or eventType = "user.authentication.sso"
| filter debugContext contains "threatSuspected\":\"true"
| alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter outcome_result = "SUCCESS" and user_name != null
| filter not (user_name contains "svc-" or user_name contains "api-" or user_name contains "default.user")
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count() as threat_auths, values(ip) as ip_list by user_name, _time
| filter threat_auths >= 3
| fields user_name, ip_list
description: ≥3 SUCCESS Okta user.session.start/user.authentication.sso events for one user in 15 min with debugContext threatSuspected=true — ThreatInsight-flagged auth burst from an AiTM reverse proxy (session.start + rapid SSO to sensitive apps).
